column1: # Book 4 second-round read (Fable, 2026-10-30): every line read against the Latin. No changes.
# 4.318 credas (319) governs all three infinitives; "that" marks 318 as the reported belief.
# 4.374 eadem is nominative with umbra (short a): the same shadow; e regione is adverbial, straight on. 4.381-382 then disputes exactly this.

column2: Further, that images walk forward in step with us, and set
seems, the same one, to have followed us straight on all along.
